summary: Place blocks to complete paths and solve building challenges for kids
description:
BUILD A PATH… AND HELP PANGO COMPLETE HIS MISSION!
Be clever! Place the blocks in the right spots to create a solid path. If Pango and his friends cross the screen without falling, they collect the item they’re looking for. Each character has a mission: Pig cooks, Fox fixes, Squirrel trains, and Rabbit creates his finest artwork!

Challenge after challenge, you adjust, test, and try again… until you find the RIGHT solution! 14 fun missions and 112 smart puzzles are waiting for you — observe, think, and build like a champion.

Pango Blocks helps your child think, observe, and understand spatial organisation while playing. Each challenge lets them progress at their own pace, in a simple, encouraging experience accessible from age 3.

A PANGO CREATION
For over 15 years, Pango games have gently supported children’s development. More than 15 million children use them worldwide. Pango Blocks continues this mission: a colourful, interactive, and accessible logic game designed to learn through trial, error, and success.

WHY PARENTS LOVE PANGO BLOCKS
- Develops logic, observation, and spatial awareness
- Encourages thinking, trial-and-error, and independence
- Includes 14 missions and 112 progressive challenges
- Colourful, interactive, fully animated world
- No stress, no timer — at your child’s own pace
- Perfect from age 3

TRY FOR FREE
Download Pango Blocks for free and enjoy a first mission included.
Unlock the remaining missions through in-app purchases: individually or as a complete pack.
All purchases are secured with parental controls.

A 100% SAFE GAME FOR CHILDREN
• No adverts  
• No external links  
• Built-in parental controls  
• Compliant with child data-protection standards  

PANGO VALUES: LOGIC, KINDNESS, INDEPENDENCE
At Pango, we create experiences designed from a child’s perspective: simple, colourful, and pressure-free. Our worlds nurture curiosity, confidence, and joyful learning.

Need help? A question? pango@studio-pango.com
